final: SELECT AVG(filtered.rating_avg) AS avg_per_day_figure, AVG(filtered.excess) AS avg_excess FROM (SELECT rating_avgs.rating, rating_avgs.rating_avg, overall_avg.across_rating_average, (rating_avgs.rating_avg - overall_avg.across_rating_average) AS excess FROM (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS rating_avg FROM film f GROUP BY f.rating) rating_avgs CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(rating_avg) AS across_rating_average FROM (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS rating_avg FROM film f GROUP BY f.rating) subq2) overall_avg WHERE rating_avgs.rating_avg > overall_avg.across_rating_average) filtered
